name: Awakening
description: After surviving 5 enemy attacks in the same battle, memories of your journey awaken the magic within you, restoring 25 HP + 25 Mana and granting +2 to your next offensive roll. Activates once per battle.
activationLine:
5 enemy attacks survived. Awakening activates!

Restored 25 HP + 25 Mana | Next offensive roll +2
